Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism

Interface CubismFacade

public interface CubismFacade
Plugin-facing view of the currently admitted Cubism host.

Snapshot methods are read-only and return SDK-owned immutable values. A present host does not imply an active project, document, model, or support for every Preview service. Model references and write facilities remain generation-bound; callers must treat unavailable or stale targets as rejected rather than attempting to retain or replace host objects.

      Returns:
      the snapshot; absent project, document, and model values represent their current absence rather than a mutable live view

      boolean isHostPresent()

    • model

      default CubismModelAccess model()
      Returns the unified generation-bound Cubism model object API.

      Calls through the returned graph are subject to read/write permission, provider admission, and generation checks. For an Editor-attached model, supported setters must route to Editor authoring state; no caller may rely on a Core evaluation mutation as an authoring write.

      Returns:
      the admitted model-access gateway
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - if this facade has no installed model provider
